query: Fredericton New Brunswick Canada taxi Uber fare per km 2026
snippet: The starting price of a taxi in Fredericton is 6.0 CAD, with each kilometer priced at 2.5 CAD. Another source: initial charge $4.50, increasing $0.23 per 120 meters. Uber is reportedly unavailable in Fredericton as of 2026 (taxi-only market).
